review_type: Reachability review for firmware allocation retry after vmalloc failure

scope.analysis_basis: Ghidra call xrefs, stock AArch64 control flow, proc_ops registration and matching reconstructed/Docker sources

joern.note: Joern does not model the AArch64 inline assembly call edge for this assembly-only method; Ghidra calls.jsonl and stock assembly establish the edge.

caller_chain.detail: proc_create("tp_self_test", 436, tpd_proc_dir, &proc_ops_tp_self_test); decimal mode 436 is octal 0664.

caller_chain.evidence: Ghidra calls.jsonl: caller tp_self_test_write, callsite 0010cc74, target tp_alloc_tp_firmware_data at 00107d54.
caller_chain.detail: Every write calls the allocator with size 0x100000.

caller_chain.evidence: stock AArch64 0073_tp_self_test_write_0010cc50.asm: call at 0x63ec, error branch at 0x63f0 to 0x6448.
caller_chain.detail: On allocator error the handler logs and returns -12; it does not call tp_free_tp_firmware_data or clear cdev+0xc58.
A failed vmalloc frees the descriptor but leaves cdev+0xc58 dangling; a subsequent authorized write re-enters the allocator and reaches its initial dereference/cleanup.

findings.disposition: STOCK_BEHAVIOR_RETAINED_ON_EXACT_BRANCH; FIX TRACKED AS SEPARATE HARDENING DEVIATION
findings.details: The stale-slot condition can be retried through the registered tp_self_test proc write entry. A first write whose 1 MiB vmalloc fails receives -ENOMEM; the handler returns without cleanup. A later write calls tp_alloc_tp_firmware_data again, which reads and inspects the freed descriptor through cdev+0xc58. This does not prove a deterministic crash; the exact invalid access depends on allocator reuse and poisoning.

evidence.stock_xref: ghidra_stock/calls.jsonl caller tp_self_test_write callsite 0010cc74 target tp_alloc_tp_firmware_data
evidence.allocator_failure: Round 15 review and Ghidra P-Code at 00107e34-00107e3c

recommendation: On a separate hardening branch, set *(struct tpd_firmware_data **)(cdev + 0xc58) to NULL immediately after freeing the descriptor on vmalloc failure. Preserve the exact reconstruction branch and its attestation.

mapping.disposition: Reachability is documented without changing the exact reconstruction.

limitations: This review establishes the path statically; it does not force a vmalloc failure or execute a second proc write.
The proc entry is writable by owner/group according to mode 0664; actual runtime credentials and deployment permissions were not tested.
No new build, host harness or hardware test was run in this read-only caller review.
Independent human review was not performed.
